meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Bank credit by sector, current classification: agriculture, industry by size, services and NBFCs, personal loans by type (housing, vehicles, cards, gold, education), priority sector, monthly since January 2019
meta.note: RBI, Deployment of Bank Credit by Major Sectors, new format, ₹ lakh crore: the DBIE export to 2026-07-31, then the monthly press-release workbooks. Bank credit, food credit and non-food credit cover all scheduled commercial banks (Section 42 return); every sector and industry row covers the selected banks of the sector-wise and industry-wise return (SIBC), about 95% of non-food credit. Each month is its last reporting fortnight; from December 2025 the last day of the month (Banking Laws (Amendment) Act 2025). From July 2023 the figures include HDFC Ltd's loans, merged into HDFC Bank: housing loans jump and loans to NBFCs drop that month. Since May 2024 one bank reclassifies a category of agricultural loans as loans against gold jewellery. Not merger-adjusted. Bank, food and non-food credit are the Section 42 figures of the same reporting date (DBIE reports 689 and 1130) wherever those reports carry it; on 2019-12-20, 2020-12-18, 2021-06-18, 2022-05-20, 2022-06-17, 2023-05-19, 2023-10-20, 2023-11-17, 2024-03-22, 2024-10-18, 2025-02-21, 2025-03-21, 2025-04-18 the export printed a different fortnight's figures.
